explication: Retro-Go is ESP32 firmware that presents a launcher and a collection of retro-game applications. The principal workflow is browsing ROMs, selecting a game, and handing off to its system-specific emulator; the README documents broad emulator coverage and launcher features. The shared retro-go component supplies device services, including storage and user-interface facilities. Source excerpts are limited, so most subsystem links below rely on explicit README descriptions; they do not assert unobserved internal calls.
